title: [main] Discount is not taken into account on Renewal Offer using Sales Quote for Subscription Billing report layout.
summary: The Subscription Billing renewal quote report now correctly applies discounts to line amounts, fixing a logic error that prevented discount copying to renewal subscription lines.
key_points: Discount percentage comparison logic was always false, blocking discount transfer
Discount is now properly applied after setting the renewal subscription line price
Added regression test confirming 50 price with 10% discount yields 45 total
quote: A self-comparison of the discount percentage always evaluated to false, preventing the discount from being copied to the Sales Subscription Line.
